result.summary: This pull request backports three merged documentation PRs to the 31.x maintenance branch for release in 31.2. It backports #36309 to mark private transaction broadcast as experimental and reframe its claims in terms of risk reduction, backports #36377 to document BIP 461 in doc/bips.md, backports #36441 to correct the upgrade guide regarding the bitcoin wrapper executable and libexec directory, and updates the v31.x release notes.
result.problem: Documentation on the 31.x branch lacked mention of BIP 461, overclaimed guarantees for private broadcast without explicitly labeling it experimental, and provided outdated upgrade instructions that could cause users to leave multiprocess libexec binaries stale when manually copying new executables.
evidence: Commit 655cf21b8c explains that since #31375, Linux installs ship a bitcoin wrapper in bin/ that dispatches to libexec/, so 'copying only bitcoind/bitcoin-qt leaves those stale. Tell users to copy over bin/ and libexec/ instead.' (Fixes #36431)
Commit d1e2b3e56b reframes private broadcast claims 'in terms of risk reduction rather than absolutes' and commit 6701d7c329 marks the feature as experimental.
result.scope_notes: Clean documentation cherry-picks to the 31.x release branch; the metadata indicates 5 files and 5 commits (+21/-9) despite the full diff against branch point showing older history.
result.changed_since_previous: Added the backport of #36441 (commit 655cf21b8c), which fixes #36431 by updating the 'How to Upgrade' instructions for the bitcoin wrapper and libexec directory.
result.card: This pull request backports documentation changes from #36309, #36377, and #36441 to the 31.x release branch for milestone 31.2. It marks private transaction broadcast as experimental and reframes its guarantees as risk reduction, adds BIP 461 to bips.md, and updates the upgrade guide to instruct users to copy both bin/ and libexec/ to prevent stale multiprocess binaries. All included pull requests have already been merged into master.

risk.why: Modifies only documentation and release notes files on a maintenance branch.
